meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 处理 git 操作时会先分析请求模式，默认把改动拆成多个小提交（按文件数和目录/职责拆分），并模仿仓库原有提交风格；也支持 rebase/squash 与历史查找。
howto.when: 当你说出“commit”、“rebase”、“squash”等关键词，或询问某段代码谁写的、何时添加、找出引入某改动的提交等时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动按目录拆成多个提交，并匹配仓库的提交风格。
say.note: 会先生成提交计划再执行。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个，重写提交信息。
say.note: 进入 rebase 流程，合并并整理历史。

say.text: 查一下这行代码是哪个提交引入的，谁写的。
say.note: 会用 blame 和 log 定位历史。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes the request mode for git operations, splits changes into multiple small commits (based on file count and directory/concern), detects and follows the repo's commit style, and supports rebase/squash and history lookup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "commit," "rebase," "squash," or ask who wrote a line, when something was added, or find the commit that introduced a change.

say_en.text: Split these changes into multiple commits by directory, and match the repo's commit style.
say_en.note: It will produce a plan first, then execute.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one and rewrite the message.
say_en.note: Enters rebase flow, merges and cleans history.

say_en.text: Find which commit introduced this line and who wrote it.
say_en.note: Uses blame and log to trace history.
